test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the highlighted word.

His __**liberal** __policies were responsible for progress in the community.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Conservative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"liberal"** means open to new behaviour or opinions and willing to discard traditional values. (उदार)

 
 
• **Example: **She is known for her **liberal **views on social issues.
 
 
 
• **"Conservative"** refers to holding traditional attitudes and values and cautious about change or innovation, typically in relation to politics or religion. (रूढ़िवादी)
 
 
• **Example: **His **conservative **policies emphasized maintaining the status quo.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'liberal'** is **'conservative'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Central** (केंद्रीय): Of, at, or forming the centre.

 
 
• **Example:** The **central **theme of the book is the struggle for freedom.
 
 
 
• **Ineffectual** (अप्रभावी): Not producing any significant or desired effect.
 
 
• **Example:** His attempts to fix the problem were **ineffectual**.
 
 
 
• **Hysterical** (उन्मादग्रस्त): Deriving from or affected by uncontrolled extreme emotion.
 
 
• **Example:** She became **hysterical **after hearing the shocking news.
 
 

17e:T1435,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
